snippet.title: Watch The Edge Honey! Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Our new game is coming out August 7th! A different, challenging, and equally terrifying experience awaits you.

Watch The Edge, Honey! is a punishing 3D vertical platformer that embodies the spirit of those mysterious, unfinished prototypes from the early 2000s. The objective is simple: ascend towards the sky with your character, Eva, performing millimeter-precise jumps and watching out for the edges. Eva will be your greatest support and companion on this challenging journey. But as you climb, you'll begin to feel that there's much more to it than just a simple block of code behind the pixels.

Here's the link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4932350/Watch_The_Edge_Honey/
